messages:
maria gonzalez: Quick sync — here's the consolidated company-level OKR draft for FY26 Q2. Need final alignment + sign-off by EOD PT tomorrow. Please ACK or flag items you can't commit to.

maria gonzalez: Draft highlights (short):
```
O1: Improve inference latency and cost-efficiency
  KR1: Reduce p50 latency on hosted API by 15%
  KR2: Cut avg token cost by 12% across top-10 customers
O2: Launch Redwood Dedicated GA
  KR1: 3 pilot customers onboarded
  KR2: <99.9% uptime SLA for reserved pools
O3: Developer experience & adoption
  KR1: 20% increase in active API projects
  KR2: Shipping SDK v3 + docs refresh
```
maria gonzalez: Quick notes: customer ask for private deployment (BankCo) is queued but not in the company OKR unless we accept the Dedicated scope bump.

alex reed: Thanks — overall looks good. Question on O1 KR2: is the 12% cost reduction across all workloads or weighted by spend? would prefer weighted by spend so it's meaningful.

samir patel: I'm concerned about Dedicated GA timeline — the infra work for autoscaling + burst is still risky. Can we stage GA to "pilot -> soft GA -> GA" and only commit full SLA for GA if infra tests pass?

jin park: Re: BankCo ask — they want VPC + HSM, timeline 10w. If we fold them into Q2, that pushes Dedicated scope (and support) by ~3w. We should decide now or we'll scramble during exec rollout.

rachael liu: Proposal: accept O2 as-is but add a gating criteria doc linked from the OKR: "Dedicated GA gated on load test X (p95 < target) + 2 pilot customers onboarded with HSM integration". That lets us keep the goal while protecting infra team.

alex reed: Agree with rachael. Also accept weighted-spend wording for O1 KR2.

samir patel: +1 to gating approach. I'll add detailed staging milestones with owners.

ops-bot: OKR doc updated by maria gonzalez — see latest changes in shared drive: https://redwood.work/okrs/q2-fy26 (automated) :memo:

jin park: I'll +1 to the OKR draft if we commit to the gating criteria and a clear rollback plan for Dedicated GA (fallback to hosted variants). I'll flag BankCo for SE to start scoping but not promise GA timeline yet.

maria gonzalez: Rollcall for sign-off (reply +1 or :thumbsup: with any short notes): alex / samir / jin / rachael / product leads / eng leads.

samir patel: +1 — I'll own staging milestones and will follow up with a short runbook for GA phases.

alex reed: +1 (weighted-spend for KR2). will update the doc to reflect wording.

jin park: +1 (will scope BankCo but keeping them out of GA commit unless infra confirms).

rachael liu: +1 — will own gating criteria doc and acceptance checklist.

maria gonzalez: Thanks all. Action items captured: samir -> staging milestones; rachael -> gating doc + checklist; alex -> wording update; jin -> BankCo scoping. I'll consolidate and ping execs for final formal sign-off tomorrow AM. :rocket:
